# Game Idea: "Pixel Runner"

- **Genre:** Endless side‑scroll runner.
- **Core Loop:** A single‑pixel avatar automatically runs left‑to‑right on a procedurally generated platform. Tap/press to make it jump over gaps and obstacles.
- **Lose Condition:** Collision with an obstacle or falling into a gap ends the game.
- **Canvas Features:** Simple sprite drawing, scrolling background, collision detection, and basic physics.

A minimal, fun game that can be built entirely with HTML5 Canvas and JavaScript.

1: // Simple endless runner for canvas with id "game"
2: // © Generated from IDEA.md - minimal implementation
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const WIDTH = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
9:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 400;
10: 
11:   // Game constants
12:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
13:   const JUMP_STRENGTH = -12;
14:   const SPEED = 4; // world scroll speed
15:   const PLATFORM_HEIGHT = 20;
16: 
17:   // Player
18:   // Sound assets
19:   const jumpSound = new Audio('jump.wav');
20:   const dieSound = new Audio('die.wav');
21:   const bgMusic = new Audio('bg.mp3');
22:   bgMusic.loop = true;
23:   bgMusic.volume = 0.3;
24:   bgMusic.play().catch(() => {}); // ignore autoplay block
25: 
26:   const player = {
27:     w: 20,
28:     h: 20,
29:     x: 50,
30:     y: HEIGHT - PLATFORM_HEIGHT - 20,
31:     vy: 0,
32:     onGround: false,
33:     draw() {
34:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(this.x + this.w/2, this.y + this.h/2, 2, this.x + this.w/2, this.y + this.h/2, this.w);
35:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff0');
36:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#ff8c00');
37:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
38:       ctx.beginPath();
39:       ctx.arc(this.x + this.w/2, this.y + this.h/2, this.w/2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
40:       ctx.fill();
41:     },
42:     update() {
43:       this.vy += GRAVITY;
44:       this.y += this.vy;
45:       // simple ground check
46:       if (this.y + this.h >= HEIGHT - PLATFORM_HEIGHT) {
47:         this.y = HEIGHT - PLATFORM_HEIGHT - this.h;
48:         this.vy = 0;
49:         this.onGround = true;
50:       } else {
51:         this.onGround = false;
52:       }
53:     },
54:     jump() {
55:       if (this.onGround) {
56:         this.vy = JUMP_STRENGTH;
57:         jumpSound.currentTime = 0;
58:         jumpSound.play().catch(() => {});
59:       }
60:     },
61:   };
62: 
63:   // Platforms & obstacles (as simple rectangles)
64:   const platforms = [];
65:   const obstacles = [];
66: 
67:   function spawnPlatform() {
68:     const w = 100 + Math.random() * 100;
69:     const gap = 50 + Math.random() * 100;
70:     const x = WIDTH;
71:     const y = HEIGHT - PLATFORM_HEIGHT;
72:     platforms.push({ x, y, w, h: PLATFORM_HEIGHT });
73:     // Maybe spawn an obstacle on the platform
74:     if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
75:       const obW = 20;
76:       const obH = 30;
77:       const obX = x + w / 2 - obW / 2;
78:       obstacles.push({ x: obX, y: y - obH, w: obW, h: obH });
79:     }
80:     // Schedule next platform after current width + gap passes
81:     setTimeout(spawnPlatform, (w + gap) / SPEED * 16); // approx frames
82:   }
83: 
84:   // Start with a few platforms
85:   for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) spawnPlatform();
86: 
87:   // Input handling
88:   function onInput() {
89:     player.jump();
90:   }
91:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') onInput(); });
92:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', onInput);
93: 
94:   function rectCollision(a, b) {
95:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
96:   }
97: 
98:   let gameOver = false;
99: 
100:   function update() {
101:     if (gameOver) return;
102:     // Move world left
103:     platforms.forEach(p => p.x -= SPEED);
104:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= SPEED);
105:     // Remove off‑screen
106:     while (platforms.length && platforms[0].x + platforms[0].w < 0) platforms.shift();
107:     while (obstacles.length && obstacles[0].x + obstacles[0].w < 0) obstacles.shift();
108:     // Update player
109:     player.update();
110:     // Collision with obstacles
111:     for (const o of obstacles) {
112:       if (rectCollision(player, o)) {
113:           gameOver = true;
114:           dieSound.currentTime = 0;
115:           dieSound.play().catch(() => {});
116:           bgMusic.pause();
117:           break;
118:         }
119:       }
120:       // Fall off platform detection (if not on ground and below platform line)
121:       if (!player.onGround && player.y + player.h > HEIGHT) {
122:         gameOver = true;
123:         dieSound.currentTime = 0;
124:         dieSound.play().catch(() => {});
125:         bgMusic.pause();
126:       }
127:   }
128: 
129:   function draw() {
130:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
131:     // Background with gradient
132:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, HEIGHT);
133:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4a90e2');
134:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#003973');
135:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
136:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
137:     // Platforms with gradient
138:     const platGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, HEIGHT - 20, 0, HEIGHT);
139:     platGrad.addColorStop(0, '#7d5a50');
140:     platGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3e2723');
141:     ctx.fillStyle = platGrad;
142:     for (const p of platforms) {
143:       ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);
144:     }
145:     // Obstacles with gradient and shape
146:     const obsGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, HEIGHT);
147:     obsGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ff5555');
148:     obsGrad.addColorStop(1, '#aa0000');
149:     ctx.fillStyle = obsGrad;
150:     for (const o of obstacles) {
151:       // draw a simple triangle obstacle
152:       ctx.beginPath();
153:       ctx.moveTo(o.x, o.y + o.h);
154:       ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y);
155:       ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w, o.y + o.h);
156:       ctx.closePath();
157:       ctx.fill();
158:     }
159:     // Player
160:     player.draw();
161:     if (gameOver) {
162:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
163:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
164:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
165:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
166:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
167:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2);
168:     }
169:   }
170: 
171:   function loop() {
172:     update();
173:     draw();
174:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
175:   }
176:   loop();
177: })();

(End of file - total 177 lines)
